steps.name: rate-limit-core
steps.summary: lib/rate-limit.ts: sliding-window rate limit core (Edge+Node) with Upstash REST primary, in-process LRU fallback (5000 keys), getClientIp/hashIp helpers; 19 specs covering memory/Upstash/headers/SHA-256.

steps.name: rate-limit-routes
steps.summary: lib/rate-limit-middleware.ts wired into /api/chat (10/min, 100/day), /api/node/feedback (5/min, 30/day), /api/node/contact (3/min, 10/day) with sha256-hashed IP keys, scope-only 429 bodies, Retry-After+X-RateLimit-Scope headers, fail-open on infra error, and 11 new specs covering deny/isolation/bypass/day-cap; 469 tests total.

steps.name: token-budget
steps.summary: lib/token-budget.ts: KST-keyed daily token cap with Upstash INCRBY+EXPIRE primary and in-memory fallback (clearTokenBudgetMemory, getKstDayKey, getTodayUsage, addTokenUsage, checkDailyTokenBudget); /api/chat early 503+Retry-After on cap and post-stream addTokenUsage from streamText.usage; MAX_TOKENS_PER_DAY=0 supported; 18 specs covering KST boundaries, memory/Upstash, bypass, integration, no-leak; 487 tests total.

steps.name: seo-meta
steps.summary: app/layout.tsx metadata expanded (title.template '%s | 김윤수', applicationName, authors, creator, keywords, alternates.canonical '/', openGraph.locale ko_KR + url + siteName, twitter summary_large_image, robots.googleBot, icons.favicon); per-page metadata adds alternates.canonical for /, /about, /experience, /contact (no openGraph.images override); JsonLdPerson adds url/description/knowsAbout (7 entries); robots.ts disallow extended to /api/node/; opengraph-image.tsx tightens alt + Pretendard→system-ui→Apple SD Gothic Neo→Noto Sans KR fallback; specs/seo-meta.spec.ts (29 specs) covering layout/viewport/page-level/JsonLdPerson/sitemap/robots; 516 tests total.
